calibration_toolbox.core.camera_calibration.plot_distortion

calibration_toolbox.core.camera_calibration.plot_distortion(sensor_size, m, d)[source]

Plot camera distortion.

Parameters

  • sensor_size (Tuple[int, int]) – The size of the sensor in pixels (width, height)

  • m (ndarray[Any, dtype[float64]]) – The intrinsics camera matrix in the OpenCV format.

  • d (ndarray[Any, dtype[float64]]) – The distortion coefficients in OpenCV format.

Return type

None
